tarea: Generate a made-up dataset following this specification to the letter. Return only the result in the format indicated in salida, with no explanations before or after.

contexto.uso: [WHAT FOR: testing a CRM import / email sequence / n8n flow / client demo]
contexto.herramienta_destino: [HUBSPOT / BREVO / GOOGLE SHEETS / AIRTABLE / SHOPIFY / OTHER]

campos.regla: Common first names in Spain, with accents. 15% compound names.
Two Spanish surnames separated by a space.
Built from the name, lowercase and without accents. Required domain: example.com or example.es. Never real domains.
Format +34 6XX 555 XXX. The 555 block is required so that it does not exist.
Made-up, plausible company names with a legal form (S.L., S.A., freelancer (autónomo)). Do not use real brands.
Real cities in Spain, spread across large and mid-sized ones.
Format YYYY-MM-DD, between [START DATE] and [END DATE].
Euros with two decimals, between [MINIMUM] and [MAXIMUM].
importe_base plus the applied VAT (IVA), rounded to two decimals. It must always add up.

tipos: email with a trailing space or without an at sign
casos_raros.marcar: Add a last column called caso_raro with the type of trap, or empty if the row is normal.

prohibido: Data of real people, including public figures
Adding columns that are not in campos

salida.nombres_columna: Use the exact names that herramienta_destino expects if you know them; if not, use those in campos and say so in one line before the block.
